children: Drug firm Neuland Laboratories Ltd on Monday (September 7) said it has approved ₹126 crore in capital expenditure for the purchase of approximately 134 acres of land at Auro Industrial City in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh.

The investment includes other related expenditure and will be funded through internal accruals. The company said the land is proposed to be used for its future expansion. There is no proposed capacity addition specified as part of the current announcement.

Neuland Laboratories also has a right of first refusal to purchase an additional contiguous land parcel of approximately 66 acres at a later date. If acquired, the potential aggregate land parcel at the location would increase to approximately 200 acres.
Shares of Neuland Laboratories Ltd ended at ₹22,955.00, up by ₹311.70, or 1.38%, on the BSE.

title: Neuland Labs clears ₹126 crore capex for 134 acres of land in Andhra Pradesh’s Kakinada
